1) **PASS** – The emerald line, gradient fill, year ticks (2026–2046), amber dashed marker with flame icon, and terminal dot are all clearly legible and well-contrasted against the dark background.
2) **PASS** – All text and UI elements use light/colored text on dark backgrounds; no black-on-dark or invisible elements are present.
3) **PASS** – The chart block is cleanly laid out with proper spacing; there is no overlap, clipping, or truncation of the chart components, labels, or annotations.
